units.locator: Article 13.5. Verifications in the Event of Dismissal (Termination of Powers) of Certain Categories of Persons
units.text: 11. When conducting the verification specified in part 4 of this Article, the Prosecutor General of the Russian Federation or subordinate prosecutors may:
units.label: Part 11 Art. 13.5

units.locator: Article 13.5. Verifications in the Event of Dismissal (Termination of Powers) of Certain Categories of Persons
units.text: 1) conduct an interview on their own initiative with the person under verification specified in part 2 of this Article;
units.label: Point 1 Part 11 Art. 13.5

units.locator: Article 13.5. Verifications in the Event of Dismissal (Termination of Powers) of Certain Categories of Persons
units.text: 2) obtain explanations from the person under verification specified in part 2 of this Article concerning the information and materials submitted by that person;
units.label: Point 2 Part 11 Art. 13.5

units.locator: Article 13.5. Verifications in the Event of Dismissal (Termination of Powers) of Certain Categories of Persons
units.text: 3) send requests according to the established procedure to public authorities and organizations for information in their possession on the income, property and property-related obligations of the person under verification specified in part 2 of this Article, their spouse and minor children, and for information on compliance with restrictions, prohibitions or requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest and/or performance of duties established for the purpose of combating corruption. Requests to credit institutions, tax authorities of the Russian Federation, bodies conducting state registration of rights to immovable property and transactions involving it, operators of information systems in which digital financial assets are issued, and the authorized body in the sphere of combating the legalization (laundering) of proceeds of crime, the financing of terrorism, extremist activities and the financing of proliferation of weapons of mass destruction shall be sent by the Prosecutor General of the Russian Federation, Deputy Prosecutors General of the Russian Federation, prosecutors of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, and military and other specialized prosecutors equivalent to prosecutors of constituent entities of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 3 Part 11 Art. 13.5

units.locator: Article 13.5. Verifications in the Event of Dismissal (Termination of Powers) of Certain Categories of Persons
units.text: 4) make inquiries of individuals and obtain information from them with their consent.
units.label: Point 4 Part 11 Art. 13.5

units.locator: Article 13.5. Verifications in the Event of Dismissal (Termination of Powers) of Certain Categories of Persons
units.text: 12. Heads of public authorities and organizations receiving a request specified in point 3 of part 11 of this Article shall arrange for its execution in accordance with federal laws and other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation and provide the requested information according to the established procedure.
units.label: Part 12 Art. 13.5

units.locator: Article 13.5. Verifications in the Event of Dismissal (Termination of Powers) of Certain Categories of Persons
units.text: 13. The procedure for considering the materials of the verification specified in part 4 of this Article shall be determined by the Prosecutor General of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 13 Art. 13.5

units.locator: Article 13.5. Verifications in the Event of Dismissal (Termination of Powers) of Certain Categories of Persons
units.text: 14. No later than one month after prosecutors complete the verification specified in part 4 of this Article, the Prosecutor General of the Russian Federation or subordinate prosecutors shall inform the person who forwarded the materials to the prosecution bodies of the Russian Federation under part 3 of this Article of its results.
units.label: Part 14 Art. 13.5

units.locator: Article 13.5. Verifications in the Event of Dismissal (Termination of Powers) of Certain Categories of Persons
units.text: 15. If, during the verification specified in part 4 of this Article, the Prosecutor General of the Russian Federation or subordinate prosecutors obtain the information specified in part 1 of Article 8.2 of this Federal Law, the Prosecutor General of the Russian Federation or subordinate prosecutors shall, no later than ten working days after obtaining that information, decide to verify the lawful receipt of the funds specified in part 3 of Article 8.2 of this Federal Law, in accordance with Article 8.2 of this Federal Law and according to the procedure provided for in that Article. The decision shall be made in writing separately in respect of each person under verification specified in part 2 of this Article. Materials obtained during the verification specified in part 4 of this Article may be used when verifying the lawful receipt of the funds specified in part 3 of Article 8.2 of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 15 Art. 13.5

units.locator: Article 13.5. Verifications in the Event of Dismissal (Termination of Powers) of Certain Categories of Persons
units.text: 16. Within their competence established by the Federal Law “On the Prosecutor’s Office of the Russian Federation”, the Prosecutor General of the Russian Federation or subordinate prosecutors shall consider the materials of the verification specified in part 4 of this Article and, where grounds exist, no later than one month after its completion, apply to a court according to the established procedure to change the grounds and wording of the dismissal (termination of powers) of the person under verification specified in part 2 of this Article.
units.label: Part 16 Art. 13.5

units.locator: Article 13.5. Verifications in the Event of Dismissal (Termination of Powers) of Certain Categories of Persons
units.text: 17. The Prosecutor General of the Russian Federation or subordinate prosecutors who receive the materials specified in part 3 of this Article concerning the person under verification specified in part 1 of this Article shall consider those materials within their competence established by the Federal Law “On the Prosecutor’s Office of the Russian Federation” and, where grounds exist, no later than four months after receipt of those materials, apply to a court according to the procedure provided for by civil procedure legislation to change the grounds and wording of the dismissal (termination of powers) of the person under verification specified in part 1 of this Article.
units.label: Part 17 Art. 13.5

units.locator: Article 13.5. Verifications in the Event of Dismissal (Termination of Powers) of Certain Categories of Persons
units.text: 18. If a court grants the application of the Prosecutor General of the Russian Federation or subordinate prosecutors specified in part 16 or 17 of this Article, the court shall change the grounds and wording of the dismissal (termination of powers) of the person under verification and shall state in its decision the grounds and wording of the dismissal (termination of powers) in exact accordance with the wording of this Federal Law or another federal law, citing the relevant article, part of an article, point or other structural unit of an article of this Federal Law or another federal law.
units.label: Part 18 Art. 13.5

units.locator: Article 14. Liability of Legal Entities for Corruption Offenses
units.text: Article 14. Liability of Legal Entities for Corruption Offenses
units.label: Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Liability of Legal Entities for Corruption Offenses
units.text: 1. If corruption offenses or offenses creating conditions for the commission of corruption offenses are organized, prepared or committed on behalf of or in the interests of a legal entity, measures of liability may be applied to that legal entity in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Liability of Legal Entities for Corruption Offenses
units.text: 2. Imposing liability on a legal entity for a corruption offense does not release the culpable individual from liability for that corruption offense, just as holding an individual criminally or otherwise liable for a corruption offense does not release the legal entity from liability for that corruption offense.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Liability of Legal Entities for Corruption Offenses
units.text: 3. The provisions of this Article apply to foreign legal entities in cases provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 15. Register of Persons Dismissed Due to Loss of Trust
units.text: Article 15. Register of Persons Dismissed Due to Loss of Trust
units.label: Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Register of Persons Dismissed Due to Loss of Trust
units.text: 1. Information on a person’s dismissal (termination of powers) due to loss of trust for committing a corruption offense, except information constituting a state secret, shall be entered into the register of persons dismissed due to loss of trust (hereinafter the register) for a period of five years from the adoption of the act that served as the basis for entry into the register.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Register of Persons Dismissed Due to Loss of Trust
units.text: 2. The register shall be published on the official website of the federal state information system in the field of state service on the Internet information and telecommunications network.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Register of Persons Dismissed Due to Loss of Trust
units.text: 3. Information on a person’s dismissal (termination of powers) due to loss of trust for committing a corruption offense shall be removed from the register in the following cases:
units.label: Part 3 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Register of Persons Dismissed Due to Loss of Trust
units.text: 1) revocation of the act that served as the basis for entering into the register information on the person who was dismissed (whose powers were terminated) due to loss of trust for committing a corruption offense;
units.label: Point 1 Part 3 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Register of Persons Dismissed Due to Loss of Trust
units.text: 2) entry into legal force according to the established procedure of a court decision revoking the act or court decision that served as the basis for entering into the register information on the person who was dismissed (whose powers were terminated) due to loss of trust for committing a corruption offense;
units.label: Point 2 Part 3 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Register of Persons Dismissed Due to Loss of Trust
units.text: 3) expiry of five years from the adoption of the act or court decision that served as the basis for entering into the register information on the person who was dismissed (whose powers were terminated) due to loss of trust for committing a corruption offense;
units.label: Point 3 Part 3 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Register of Persons Dismissed Due to Loss of Trust
units.text: 4) death of the person who was dismissed (whose powers were terminated) due to loss of trust for committing a corruption offense.
units.label: Point 4 Part 3 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Register of Persons Dismissed Due to Loss of Trust
units.text: 4. Entry into the register of information on a person who was dismissed (whose powers were terminated) due to loss of trust for committing a corruption offense, removal from the register of information on such a person, and publication of the register on the official website of the federal state information system in the field of state service on the Internet information and telecommunications network shall be carried out according to the procedure determined by the Government of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 15
